8 Days Tsavo East Tsavo West Amboseli Maasai Mara

Package overview

Embark on an unforgettable 8-day journey through the heart of Kenya, experiencing four of the country’s most iconic and diverse national parks. This itinerary is designed to immerse you in a world of dramatic landscapes, from the sprawling, arid plains of Tsavo and the majestic, elephant-filled marshes of Amboseli, to the rolling savannahs of the Maasai Mara, host to the spectacular Great Migration. Get ready to witness the unparalleled majesty of Africa’s “Big Five” and the rich cultural heritage of the Maasai people, creating memories that will last a lifetime.

  • Tsavo East National Park
  • "Red" Elephants: The elephants here are famous for wallowing and dust-bathing in the rich red soil, giving them a distinctive crimson color.
  • Vast Open Wilderness: Experience the sheer scale of one of Kenya's oldest and largest parks, with its beautiful acacia woodlands and sweeping savannah.
  • Tsavo West National Park
  • Mzima Springs: Visit this magical oasis where crystal-clear water gushes from the ground. You can walk to an underwater viewing chamber to see hippos, fish, and crocodiles.
  • Volcanic Scenery: Explore the dramatic terrain, including the Shetani Lava Flows, a dark, solidified river of volcanic rock, offering a stark contrast to the plains.
  • Amboseli National Park
  • Kilimanjaro Views: Capture the iconic photo of the snow-capped mountain rising above the dusty plains, especially at sunrise.

Day-by-day itinerary

01Day 1 | Nairobi/Mombasa to Tsavo East National Park

Morning: Pick up from your location. Begin the drive to Tsavo East, known for its sheer vastness and ‘Red Elephants’. Lunch: Arrive at your camp/lodge for check-in and lunch. Afternoon: Set out for an afternoon game drive, visiting key areas like the Aruba Dam which attracts a high concentration of animals. Dinner & Overnight: Tsavo East area.

02Day 2 | Tsavo East to Tsavo West National Park

Morning: Early morning game drive in Tsavo East. After breakfast, check out and drive to Tsavo West National Park (approx. 2-3 hours). Mid-day: Arrive, check-in, and have lunch. Afternoon: Game drive in Tsavo West, which is more mountainous and wet. Visit the incredible Mzima Springs, a series of four natural springs, and the Shetani Lava Flows. Dinner & Overnight: Tsavo West area.

03Day 3 | Tsavo West to Amboseli National Park

Morning: Early morning game drive in Tsavo West. After breakfast, depart for Amboseli National Park (approx. 3-4 hours). Mid-day: Arrive in Amboseli, check-in, and have lunch. Afternoon: Enjoy a game drive in Amboseli, famed for its large herds of elephants and the breathtaking backdrop of Mount Kilimanjaro. Dinner & Overnight: Amboseli area.

04Day 4 | Full Day in Amboseli National Park

Morning: Early game drive. This is the best time for clear views and photos of the snow-capped peak of Mount Kilimanjaro before the clouds roll in. Focus on the swamp areas where wildlife congregates. Mid-day: Return to the lodge for lunch and relaxation. Afternoon: Another extensive game drive, or an optional visit to a local Maasai village for a cultural experience. Dinner & Overnight: Amboseli area.

05Day 5 | Amboseli to Lake Naivasha

Morning: After breakfast, begin the long but scenic drive towards the Great Rift Valley, heading to Lake Naivasha (approx. 6-7 hours). Lunch: Stop for a packed lunch en route or at a restaurant near Nairobi/Naivasha. Afternoon: Arrive at Lake Naivasha. Check-in and immediately embark on a boat safari on the lake to see hippos and numerous bird species. Follow with a guided walking safari on Crescent Island (known for grazing giraffes, zebras, and antelopes). Dinner & Overnight: Lake Naivasha area.

06Day 6 | Lake Naivasha to Maasai Mara National Reserve

Morning: Have an early breakfast. You could opt for an early morning visit to Hell’s Gate National Park for a bicycle tour (if time allows and based on preference), or depart directly for the Maasai Mara (approx. 5-6 hours). Lunch: Arrive at your lodge/camp in the Mara area, check-in, and have lunch. Afternoon: Head out for your first exciting game drive in the world-famous Maasai Mara, home to the ‘Big Five’ and spectacular landscapes. Dinner & Overnight: Maasai Mara area.

07Day 7 | Full Day in Maasai Mara

Full Day : Dedicate the entire day to exploring the vast Maasai Mara. Optional: A spectacular Hot Air Balloon Safari at sunrise, followed by a champagne breakfast on the plains. Main Activity : Full-day game drive with a packed picnic lunch (“bush lunch”). Focus on tracking the big cats (lions, cheetahs, and leopards) and visiting the Mara River (especially crucial during the Great Migration season, July-October). Dinner & Overnight: Maasai Mara area.

08Day 8 | Maasai Mara to Nairobi

Morning: Enjoy a final early morning game drive. Return to the lodge for a hearty breakfast. Mid-day: Check out and begin the drive back to Nairobi (approx. 5-6 hours). Afternoon/Evening: Arrive in Nairobi, and transfer to Jomo Kenyatta International Airport (JKIA) for your onward flight, or drop off at your hotel. Please note that this safari is fully customizable to suit your travel preferences. You may choose to begin and end the tour in Nairobi, or start in Nairobi and finish in Mombasa if you plan to enjoy a beach extension along the Kenyan Coast. Our experienced Tour Consultants at Magical Africa Safaris are always ready to guide you and help tailor your trip for the best possible wildlife holiday experience.

What's included

  • Game drives in custom 4x4 vehicles with expert guides

What's excluded

  • Soft drinks, alcoholic beverages, and snacks
  • Personal purchases or souvenirs
  • Optional activities (e.g., guided nature walks, cultural visits)
  • Tips and gratuities for driver/guide
  • Items of personal nature (e.g., jackets, binoculars, cameras)
  • Accommodation before or after the safari
  • Travel insurance or international medical cover

From-prices are planning figures for two adults sharing, in a private vehicle with a guide, at the season shown. Your written quote is the only price that applies. International flights, visas, tips, drinks and gorilla permits are separate unless the quote lists them.
